message.reasoning:
The user wants expected ticket price for flight from first airport in system list to second airport, date 2024-11-15, economy class.

We need to fetch list of all airports via list_all_airports. Then pick first two entries (assuming order). Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=airport1.code, travel_to=airport2.code, travel_date="2024-11-15", travel_class="economy". That returns cost presumably. So we need to invoke list_all_airports then get_flight_cost. Let's do it stepwise. We'll call list_all_airports first.
